bio: I'm Owais Javaid, a Senior Creative Designer and Visual Storyteller based in Karachi, Pakistan. Over the past 5+ years, I've been delivering high-impact visual communication, brand identity systems, video production, and AI-powered creative solutions across NGO, agency, and corporate environments.

My work spans brand identity, graphic design, video production, motion graphics, and digital content — built for organizations that want to make a real impression. Currently, I'm at Patients' Aid Foundation, where I translate a life-saving healthcare mission into compelling visual campaigns, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate creative production workflows.
personal.quote: I don't just make things look good. I ask: what do we want people to feel? What action should they take? Then I design backward from that answer.
personal.contactCTA: If you're a nonprofit, startup, or brand that needs a designer who cares about the work as much as you do — let's talk.
